note: Public-safe synthetic fixture for guild_hall/engineering_engine/mcp/ (the engine MCP door, design 9.1A). The `profile` block below is the documentation copy: every path is the placeholder <abs> because a real profile is a private file whose paths point into _workspaces/** and _workmeta/**, and this repository holds no such path. A test builds a temporary profile with real temporary paths and asserts its key set against this block, so the documented shape cannot drift from the validator. The `observation_run` block is an invented observation run: the token is one the synthetic ordering fixture already declares, the counts are made up, and nothing here names an actual project, contract, organisation, document or person.

file_door_profile.note: The optional block a project adds when it opens the file door (문 앞 칸, 09장 §9.1D). Absent means the project has no door and every file tool refuses with ENGINE_MCP_FILE_DOOR_DISABLED; present means all four keys are present, because a door with an intake folder and no trash refuses at the moment somebody needs it. Every path lies under project_root. confidential_dirs stands alone: a project may mark its contract folders without opening a door.

path_roots.note: Which repository root each path field may sit under. `rule_assets` is .registry/skills/se_foldertree_generate/codex/assets — the compiled rule specs a project points at rather than copies.

expected.note: Hand-written. The tool set is fixed at twenty-three with eight write tools (thirteen since 2026-08-18, plus whoami · engine_status · access_table · projects_list, plus the six file-door tools of 2026-08-19); the synthetic project stands on two gates and one observation.
